conclusion: Overall test result: PASS WITH OBSERVATIONS.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.objective: Manual Flight in GPS Mode: Initial Precision Landing
flights.mission:
Performed a manual flight in GPS mode. A precision landing command was issued from the computer.
The drone successfully initiated and completed the landing procedure. However, it did not land precisely at the centre of the AprilTag.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.objective: GPS Mode: Repeated Landing Attempts from 10 m Altitude
flights.mission:
During the second flight, the drone climbed to 10 m altitude and was moved approximately 10 m away from the take-off position.
A landing command was issued from the computer. On the first two attempts, the drone climbed to 30 m and switched to Loiter mode instead of completing the landing.
On the third attempt, I manually lowered the drone to approximately 5 m altitude. After another landing command was issued, the drone moved above the AprilTag and completed the landing autonomously.
However, the drone again landed off-centre relative to the AprilTag.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.objective: GPS Mode: Landing Attempts from Different Positions
flights.mission:
Performed another manual flight. The drone was positioned approximately 15 m away from the AprilTag at an altitude of 5 m.
Attempt 1: After the landing command, the drone climbed to 30 m and switched to Loiter.
Attempt 2: The drone was lowered to 5 m again. After the landing command, it climbed to 18.7 m, moved above the AprilTag, then climbed further to 30 m and switched to Loiter.
Attempt 3: The drone was lowered to 5 m and positioned approximately 10 m away from the AprilTag. Following the landing command, it moved towards the AprilTag. It first climbed to approximately 18 m, then returned above the AprilTag and landed autonomously.
The final landing was successful, although the drone did not touch down precisely at the centre of the AprilTag.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.anomalies:
Performed another flight, climbing to an altitude of 10 m. A rope was attached to the AprilTag to allow it to be moved during the landing procedure.
Once the drone detected the AprilTag and began descending, we slightly rotated the AprilTag.
The drone then climbed back to approximately 10 m and attempted to reacquire the AprilTag. After detecting it again, the drone restarted the landing procedure.
When the drone descended to approximately 0.5 m above the AprilTag, we pulled the AprilTag away from underneath the drone. The drone then landed on the ground.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.objective: GNSS-Denied Mode: AprilTag Detected but Landing Not Initiated
flights.mission:
Performed another flight and climbed to 10 m. The drone was moved slightly to the left and its yaw orientation was adjusted. GNSS-Denied mode was then enabled, and a landing command was issued from the computer.
The drone moved above the AprilTag and detected it, but the landing procedure did not start.
I then reduced the altitude slightly, moved the drone further to the left, and adjusted its yaw orientation again.
After approximately one minute, the drone began drifting autonomously to the left while losing altitude.
To recover control, I switched back to GPS mode, selected Manual mode, and landed the drone safely.
flights.anomalies: The drone began drifting autonomously to the left while losing altitude.
flights.action: To recover control, I switched back to GPS mode, selected Manual mode, and landed the drone safely.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.objective: GNSS-Denied Mode: Landing Command Not Executed
flights.mission:
Performed another flight, climbing to 8 m. The drone was moved slightly to the left, and its yaw orientation was adjusted before enabling GNSS-Denied mode.
A landing command was issued from the computer, but the drone remained at approximately 8 m altitude and did not initiate the landing procedure.
I switched back to GPS mode, selected Manual mode, and landed the drone safely.
flights.anomalies: The drone did not initiate the landing
flights.action: I switched back to GPS mode, selected Manual mode, and landed the drone safely.

flights.weather: temperature : 15 Celcius wind : 3 btf-West-Gusts 30 km/h Clouds : Cloudy
flights.objective: GNSS Denied landing. Repeated Aborted Landing Attempts
flights.mission:
During this flight, the drone climbed to 10 m. Its position was shifted slightly to the left, and its yaw orientation was adjusted.
The drone moved above the AprilTag and began descending. However, at approximately 20 cm above the ground, it climbed back to 10 m.
This sequence occurred three times. Following the third attempt, the drone climbed to 30 m and remained at that altitude.
I switched back to GPS mode, selected Manual mode, and landed the drone safely.
flights.anomalies: The drone climbed to 30 m and remained at that altitude.
flights.action: I switched back to GPS mode, selected Manual mode, and landed the drone safely.

flights.objective: GPS Mode: Offboard Mode Controller and Tective MAVLink Update
flights.mission:

Before the flight, the Offboard mode controller was changed and an update was applied to Tective MAVLink.
The drone moved above the AprilTag but then climbed to 30 m and remained there.
I took manual control and landed the drone safely.

flights.objective: GNSS-Denied Mode: Two Consecutive Autonomous Landings
flights.mission:
Performed two consecutive flight/landing cycles without returning the drone and land it between the two attempts.
For each attempt, the drone climbed to 10 m, was moved slightly to the left, and had its yaw orientation adjusted before GNSS-Denied mode was enabled.
A landing command was then issued from the computer.
On both attempts, the drone moved above the AprilTag and landed autonomously.
However, neither landing was precisely centred on the AprilTag.

flights.anomalies:
Performed another flight at 10 m altitude. The drone was moved slightly to the left, and its yaw orientation was adjusted.
The drone initially began drifting forward.
I switched to Manual mode and repositioned it to approximately its previous position, almost directly above the AprilTag. I then enabled GNSS-Denied mode again.
The drone subsequently completed the landing autonomously.
